name: 1pcs Multicolor Lazy Pineapple Shaped Reusable Fiber Make Up Remover Clean Sponge Random Colour
description:
1pcs Multicolor Lazy Pineapple Shaped Reusable Fiber Make Up Remover Clean Sponge 
Soft and elastic, fits the face. 
The texture is fine, rich and even. 
Special microfiber, strong decontamination. 
Multi-functional, can be used as a face wash, can also be used as a makeup remover. 
Lightweight and compact, it is easy to carry. 
The straight, arrive as fast as seven days 
Noted: Color is Random White,Chocolate,Pink,Rose Pink,Ash
